_about: Certainty policy of judge_fragments (2.5), decision 10/18: check 8 'verified structure'.
verified_structures_only: true -> a judgement that passes the seven checks is certain only when its structure
signature is in verified_structures.json (else failed_conditions gets unverified_structure); false -> the seven
checks alone. The environment variable CLAVIEW_V3_VERIFIED_STRUCTURES_ONLY (1/0) overrides this for a run.
signature.condition_kinds: condition kinds whose place goes into the signature (basis with its axis);
signature.markers: marker values (function, display) that steer the attribution (2-4 rules 5 and 7) and so go
into the signature too. Other markers do not.
split_grounding (user decision 10/18 14:39): true -> every requirement of a split needs a grounding table;
ungrounded pieces are reattached to another requirement (failed_conditions: reattached) or the split stays as
read (ungrounded_split). The environment variable CLAVIEW_V3_SPLIT_GROUNDING (1/0) overrides this for a run.
2026-10-19 user decision: verified_structures_only false (check 8 off) after check 9 'no_indicator' and the rule fixes;
held-out generated sets 9393/9494: certain 549, wrong 4 (0.7%). The check and verified_structures.json are kept.
